glosses: thick-skinned (insensitive to the feelings of others)
Lacking in refinement or civility; bad-mannered; discourteous.

examples.text: This girl was so rude towards the cashier by screaming at him for no apparent reason.
Karen broke up with Fred because he was often rude to her.
